lines.lyric_translation: Do whatever you want
Break out of the mold with us
And gather at our hiding place right now

lines.lyric: STEP OUT do what you want
lines.lyric_hangul: Step out do what you want
lines.lyric_translation: STEP OUT do what you want
Just try everything to keep it
In your memories, now or never

lines.lyric: Ssahigo ssahilsurok neon jeomjeom deo jichyeoga
lines.lyric_hangul: 쌓이고 쌓일수록 넌 점점 더 지쳐가
lines.lyric_translation: As things build up more and more, you’ll just get more worn out
You’ll want to escape, wondering if you should just give up on it all
You’re there holding on

lines.lyric: Unlock hareo ga all right yeah
lines.lyric_translation: And we’ll go to unlock you, all right, yeah
Even if you don’t know it yourself you can

lines.lyric: Igoseseon neon jashineul noeul su isseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 이곳에선 넌 자신을 놓을 수 있어
lines.lyric_translation: Let yourself go here
The place your compass is pointing to

lines.lyric: Feeling so alive modeun geol hwinallyeo
lines.lyric_hangul: Feeling so alive 모든 걸 휘날려
lines.lyric_translation: Feeling so alive, everything is blowing around in the wind
Don’t go anywhere today
You gotta STAY with me
Look into each other’s eyes
And comfortably just sing
You can do anything, I don’t mind
‘Cause we are wild and free
Do whatever you want
Break out of the mold with us
And gather at our hiding place right now

lines.lyric: STEP OUT do what you want
lines.lyric_hangul: Step out do what you want
lines.lyric_translation: STEP OUT do what you want
Just try everything to keep it
In your memories, now or never

lines.lyric_hangul: Whoa oh oh 몸이 가는 대로
lines.lyric_translation: Woah oh oh, wherever your body takes you

lines.lyric_hangul: Whoa oh oh I wanna stay with you
lines.lyric_translation: Woah oh oh, I wanna STAY with you

lines.lyric_hangul: Whoa oh oh 맘이 가는 대로
lines.lyric_translation: Woah oh oh, wherever your heart takes you
Keep it all in your memories, now or never
It’s now or never

lines.lyric: Hwanhan byeoldeureul barabomyeo nan norae bulleo
lines.lyric_hangul: 환한 별들을 바라보며 난 노래 불러
lines.lyric_translation: I sing while looking up to the bright stars

lines.lyric: Hwanho sorie matchweoseo mamkkeot chumeul chumyeo
lines.lyric_hangul: 환호 소리에 맞춰서 맘껏 춤을 추며
lines.lyric_translation: I dance however I like to the sound of cheers
Even if people tell me I’m crazy
I feel more comfortable

lines.lyric_hangul: 꽉 묶어 버린 내 팔과 다리 이제는 소용없어
lines.lyric_translation: It won’t do anything / Even if my arms and legs are tied

parts.lyric: Kkwak mukkeo beorin nae palgwa dari

lines.lyric_hangul: 꽉 묶인 채로 산처럼 쌓인 내 짐을 끌어당겨
lines.lyric_translation: Even tied tight I’ll drag on the weight / I carry piled up like a mountain

lines.lyric: Naega hago shipeun daero nami shikin daero malgo
lines.lyric_hangul: 내가 하고 싶은 대로 남이 시킨 대로 말고
lines.lyric_translation: I’ll do whatever I want, not doing what others tell me to
To anywhere I’ll fly away so
You can do anything, I don’t mind
‘Cause we are wild and free

Break out of the mold with us
And gather at our hiding place right now
